checks.text: With no input, the page shows the heading "Age Calculator", the text "Enter a birth date to begin", and the result summary displays "Years: 0", "Months: 0", "Days: 0".

Typing "1990-01-15" in the field labelled "Birth date" and clicking the button "Calculate" shows the result summary with "Years: 35", "Months: 0", "Days: 15" (assuming today is 2025-01-30 for this test context).

Typing "1990-01-15" in the field labelled "Birth date" and "2025-06-15" in the field labelled "Reference date", then clicking "Calculate", shows the result summary with "Years: 35", "Months: 5", "Days: 0".

Typing "1990-02-29" in the field labelled "Birth date" and "2025-03-01" in the field labelled "Reference date", then clicking "Calculate", shows the result summary with "Years: 35", "Months: 0", "Days: 1" (leap day handling).

Typing "2025-01-01" in the field labelled "Birth date" and "2024-12-31" in the field labelled "Reference date", then clicking "Calculate", shows the message "Reference date must be on or after birth date" and the result summary remains "Years: 0", "Months: 0", "Days: 0".
After calculating with Birth date "1990-01-15" and Reference date "2025-06-15", the breakdown table contains a row with "Total days" and the value "12954".
After calculating with Birth date "1990-01-15" and Reference date "2025-06-15", the chart area displays a bar labelled "Years" with a value of "35".

Typing "1990-01-15" in the field labelled "Birth date" and clicking "Calculate" without a reference date uses the current date; if the current date is 2025-01-30, the result shows "Years: 35", "Months: 0", "Days: 15".

Reload keeps the calculated age: after entering Birth date "1990-01-15", Reference date "2025-06-15", clicking "Calculate", and reloading the page, the result summary still shows "Years: 35", "Months: 5", "Days: 0".
